none: PAS LIN-EEF3B5: Roman nummus of Helena
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A worn and incomplete copper-alloy Roman nummus of Helena (AD 324-341), dating to the period AD 337-340 (Reece Period 17). PAX PV-BLICA reverse type depicting Pax standing left holding branch and transverse sceptre. Mint unknown. Obverse description: Draped bust right. Obverse inscription: Illegible. Reverse description: Pax standing facing left holding branch and transverse Sceptre. Reverse inscription: [Illegible. Diameter: 13.84 mm; Thickness 1.62 mm; Weight: 1.21g
